title: Mixing AI and hand-drawn art in a playable turn-based browser RPG
author: konekochan002
selftext:
Hey everyone! I’m the solo dev of **ChatBoss**. Create a room, send your friends the link, and play together. Bots can fill the empty seats, and guest mode lets you try it without signing up.

This project mixes AI-generated artwork with hand-drawn contributions from friends. The music comes from CC0 tracks.

The game uses React and TypeScript, with Three.js for lighting and depth effects, rather than a game engine. The attached footage was captured directly from the game at 60 fps. I slowed the game clock during capture to avoid dropped frames, then edited the sequence to keep each ultimate and voice line intact.

There’s currently one PvE boss in the beta. I’m open to feedback on any part of the game, so feel free to share what you like, what feels off, or anything you’d change (or a simple idea/suggestion)!

There’s currently one PvE boss in the beta. I’d appreciate feedback on how well the different visual assets fit together, and whether the fight is readable to someone seeing it for the first time.

**Play:** [https://chatboss.live/en](https://chatboss.live/en) for free, guest mode available, best on PC for now.
